releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.201: Home Screen widget can now be manually resized both Left–Right and Upper–Neeche. The widget adjusts its layout to the available width and height; at shorter heights, the date is hidden and vertical padding is reduced. Four independent shortcuts and individual 3D press feedback are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Removed the temporary Web Update 363 test label from the Me screen. No other Diary feature or APK change.
